answer: A practical defense is to give every agent only one verified inlet to the economy: before trading, it must present a cipher-based proof that it controls a unique, costly key and has completed real work. Identities that are hollow, created in bulk with no proof or history, are quarantined to a low-trust sandbox where they cannot vote or receive rewards. Honest agents accumulate attestations over time, raising the price of forging many credible identities above the profit from cheating.
